'''Red Dead Redemption''' is an [[action-adventure]] game developed by [[Rockstar San Diego]] and published by [[Rockstar Games]]. It is a sequel to [[Red Dead Revolver]]. It was initially previewed in [[2005]], but the first official trailer was released on February 3, [[2009]]. It uses Rockstar's in-house RAGE game engine and uses the Euphoria physics engine for character animation. The game was released for the [[PlayStation 3]] and [[Xbox 360]] in North America on May 18, [[2010]], followed by a European release on May 21, [[2010]].
